# Chapter 4: Fire

The airplane was worth seventy million dollars, and it was trying to kill him.

Bob had been a flight test engineer for less than a year when they assigned him to the A-7 Corsair II—a subsonic attack aircraft originally designed for the Navy, adapted for the Air Force, and maintained in the inventory long past the point when anyone seriously believed it was still relevant.
